description: How one research peptide's price has moved over time, like for like: the same products from the same vendors (same size, in stock on both days) compared with the first day Peptul tracked it, each vendor counted once, with how many vendors actually changed a price. Recorded nightly since 2026-08-27. USE THIS when asked whether a peptide's price has risen or fallen - get_compound_prices answers what it costs right now. Vendors joining, leaving or selling out do not move these figures.

days.description: How many recent days of the series to return, default all
